Proxy Materials for 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders

On March 30, 2026, MediWound Ltd. (the “Company”) published notice of the upcoming 2026 annual general meeting of shareholders of the Company to be held on May 6, 2026 (the “Meeting”). Annexed hereto and incorporated herein by reference are copies of the following documents being distributed by the Company to its shareholders in connection with the Meeting:

 
(i)
Notice of 2026 Annual General Meeting and Proxy Statement, each dated March 30, 2026, in connection with the Meeting (annexed as Exhibit 99.1 hereto); and
 
 
(ii)
Proxy Card to be distributed to shareholders of record of the Company for use in connection with the Meeting (annexed as Exhibit 99.2 hereto).

The following exhibits are furnished as part of this Report of Foreign Private Issuer on Form 6-K (this “Form 6-K”):
